name: 3d-printer-remote
description: Agent bridge for Creality Print 7.2 and a Creality CR-10 SE. Not yet hardware-verified on a CR-10 SE (printer protocol from K1-family firmware; tests use a fake printer). Your AI agent detects the slicer, edits copies of presets, slices 3MF/STL from the command line, checks bed fit, reads live printer data, runs a print queue with filament swaps, tracks history, cost, filament and maintenance, and watches prints with a camera. Physical actions (start, pause, resume, cancel, heat, home, move, fan, cooldown, filament extrude/retract/load/unload) run only after the owner says yes in chat and an automatic preflight check passes. The one exception is an urgent cooldown (heaters off) for jams, runaway heat or crashes.
